mrs.title: Add OAuth 2.0 Google login support
mrs.description: Implements Google OAuth flow in the auth service. Adds OAuth handler, token exchange, and profile mapping.

mrs.title: Fix session token expiry bug
mrs.description: Session tokens were not being invalidated on password change. Fixes the session manager to clear tokens on auth events.

tc_results.error_message: OAuthError: Token exchange failed - invalid client_secret in config
AssertionError: Session still valid after timeout period. Token invalidation not triggered on password change.

mrs.title: Implement bulk order discount tiers
mrs.description: Adds tiered discount logic to the discount engine. Orders above 25 units get 10% off, above 50 units get 15% off.

mrs.title: Add promo code validation endpoint
mrs.description: New API endpoint to validate promo codes at checkout. Checks expiry, usage limits, and eligibility.

tc_results.tc_name: Apply valid promo code at checkout
tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Discount not applied. PromoValidator returning null for valid code SAVE10.
AssertionError: Expected 15% discount for 50 units, got 10%. Tier boundary condition off by one.

mrs.title: International card payment support
mrs.description: Enables payment gateway to accept non-domestic cards. Adds currency conversion and country-specific flags.

mrs.title: Add refund processing flow
mrs.description: Implements full refund flow for cancelled orders. Integrates with payment gateway refund API.

mrs.title: Order status state machine
mrs.description: Replaces ad-hoc status updates with a formal state machine. Enforces valid transitions and blocks invalid ones.

tc_results.error_message: PaymentError: Gateway rejected international card. Missing international_enabled flag in gateway_config.
RefundError: gateway_client.initiate_refund() raised AttributeError - method not found in current client version.

tc_results.tc_name: Order creation with multiple line items

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Transition from Confirmed to Shipped allowed without Processing step. State machine missing intermediate validation.

mrs.title: Email notification templates redesign
mrs.description: Updates all transactional email templates. New HTML layout, updated branding, improved mobile rendering.

mrs.title: Fix SMTP retry logic
mrs.description: Email sends were failing silently on SMTP timeout. Adds retry with exponential backoff and dead letter queue.

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Email not received within 2 minutes. template_renderer raising Jinja2 UndefinedError on new template.
AssertionError: Tracking number missing from email body. Template variable {{tracking_number}} not resolved.
TimeoutError: Test waited 60s for email but SMTP sandbox was unavailable in CI environment. Not a product issue.

mrs.title: Elasticsearch product search integration
mrs.description: Replaces SQL-based product search with Elasticsearch. Adds relevance scoring and keyword highlighting.

mrs.title: Real-time stock level updates
mrs.description: Stock levels now updated in real-time via event stream after each order. Replaces scheduled batch sync.

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Search returned 0 results for 'laptop'. Elasticsearch index empty - reindex not triggered after migration.
AssertionError: Category filter not applied. query_builder missing filter clause for category field.
AssertionError: Stock level not decremented after purchase. order_event_handler not receiving order.completed events.

mrs.title: Discount engine refactor - strategy pattern
mrs.description: Refactors discount engine to use strategy pattern. Each discount type is now a separate strategy class.

mrs.title: Add stacked discount conflict resolution
mrs.description: Implements priority-based conflict resolution when multiple discount rules apply to the same order.

tc_results.tc_name: Apply valid promo code at checkout

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Percentage discount returning 0. strategy_factory not mapping percentage type to PercentageStrategy after refactor.
AssertionError: Fixed discount not applied when order total equals minimum spend exactly. Off-by-one in eligibility check.

tc_results.tc_name: Price rule: buy X get Y free
tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: BOGO rule not triggering. bogo_strategy.apply() not registered in strategy_factory mapping.
AssertionError: Both conflicting rules applied simultaneously. conflict_resolver priority check not implemented.

mrs.title: Account lockout mechanism
mrs.description: Implements brute force protection. Locks account after 5 failed login attempts and sends lockout notification.

mrs.title: Guest checkout flow
mrs.description: Allows users to complete checkout without creating an account. Guest sessions linked to email only.

tc_results.tc_name: Account lockout after repeated failed logins
tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Account not locked after 5 attempts. lockout_manager.check_threshold() using wrong counter key.
AssertionError: Guest checkout redirecting to account creation page instead of proceeding. Route guard not recognising guest session.
ConnectionError: Payment sandbox unreachable during test run. Infrastructure issue confirmed by DevOps - not product defect.

mrs.title: Payment gateway client upgrade to v3 API
mrs.description: Upgrades the payment gateway client to use the new v3 API. Breaking changes in refund and tokenisation endpoints.

mrs.title: Order line item validation
mrs.description: Adds server-side validation for order line items. Checks product exists, stock available, and price matches catalogue.

tc_results.error_message: PaymentError: tokeniser.create_token() returning 404. v3 API uses /tokens endpoint, client still calling /v2/tokenise.
AssertionError: Declined payment raising unhandled exception instead of returning error response. v3 error format not handled.
PaymentError: International flag not forwarded in v3 API payload. Field renamed from international_enabled to allow_international.
RefundError: refund_processor calling deprecated v2 refund endpoint. v3 endpoint is /payments/{id}/refunds.

tc_results.tc_name: Order creation with multiple line items
tc_results.error_message: ValidationError: line_item_validator rejecting valid products due to case-sensitive SKU comparison bug.

mrs.title: Add push notification support
mrs.description: Extends notifications service to send push notifications via FCM in addition to email.

mrs.title: Inventory low stock alerts
mrs.description: Triggers notifications when stock drops below threshold. Sends alert to inventory managers via email.

mrs.title: Discount engine: minimum spend eligibility
mrs.description: Adds minimum spend checks to discount engine. Discounts only apply if order meets minimum spend threshold.

mrs.title: Session manager: concurrent session control
mrs.description: Limits users to 3 concurrent sessions. New logins beyond the limit invalidate the oldest session.

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Concurrent session limit not enforced. session_store.count_active() returning stale count after 4th login.

tc_results.tc_name: Apply valid promo code at checkout

tc_results.error_message: AssertionError: Fixed discount applied to orders below minimum spend. eligibility_checker using < instead of <= for threshold comparison.
